notes: Combined candidate theme library from the Rep Wars design discussion.
Core World is treated as the baseline gameplay world rather than one of the 112 special candidate themes.
Christmas Tree Mountains and Tuna Isles are included from the earlier established-theme baseline.
Themes are candidate world identities, not final campaign-level assignments.
Theme identity and reusable strategic challenge systems should remain separate in the eventual game architecture.

themes.name: Tutorial Realm
themes.visualIdentity: Guided introductory world designed to teach the core systems.
themes.twist: Structured introduction to the core game.

themes.name: Barren Desert
themes.visualIdentity: Arid desert landscape with scarce food and harsh terrain.
themes.twist: Drought can evolve into declining food, famine, and unrest.

themes.name: Frozen World
themes.visualIdentity: Frozen landscapes, snow, ice, and harsh winter conditions.
themes.twist: Winter conditions make movement and resources more difficult.

themes.name: Archipelago
themes.visualIdentity: Fragmented island world separated by water.
themes.twist: Expansion requires dealing with separated pockets of territory.

themes.name: Christmas Tree Mountains
themes.visualIdentity: Whimsical evergreen mountain world with snow, decorated-looking pine trees, and cozy settlements.
themes.strategicChallenge: Winter conditions without making the level a duplicate of the main frozen world.
themes.twist: Dense forests make expansion visually and strategically interesting.

themes.name: Tuna Isles
themes.visualIdentity: Absurd, playful ocean world with bizarre island shapes and aquatic visual motifs.
themes.strategicChallenge: Isolated territory and unusual resource placement.
themes.twist: A deliberately silly world identity.

themes.name: Ancient Wildwood
themes.visualIdentity: Enormous old-growth forest with clearings, giant trees, mossy areas, and ruins.
themes.strategicChallenge: Dense terrain makes movement and expansion more difficult.
themes.twist: Established areas can become highly productive once developed.

themes.name: The Emerald Basin
themes.visualIdentity: Lush, extremely fertile green valley.
themes.strategicChallenge: Abundant resources attract rapid AI expansion.
themes.twist: The player has a rich environment, but so does everybody else.

themes.name: Thornlands
themes.visualIdentity: Beautiful but tangled wilderness filled with dense thorny vegetation.
themes.strategicChallenge: Expansion through undeveloped land costs more.
themes.twist: Cleared and developed territory becomes disproportionately valuable.

themes.name: The Great Wetlands
themes.visualIdentity: Marshes, islands, boardwalk settlements, mist, and shallow water.
themes.twist: Waterways become the efficient travel network.

themes.name: Whispering Pines
themes.visualIdentity: Huge northern pine forest with scattered valleys and mountain lakes.
themes.twist: Remote settlements are harder to support but can become valuable frontier strongholds.

themes.name: Iron Hills
themes.visualIdentity: Rugged mountains, mines, cliffs, and winding valleys.
themes.twist: Resource-rich mountain territory is strategically important.

themes.name: The Great Canyon
themes.visualIdentity: Massive canyon network with bridges, plateaus, and river bottoms.
themes.strategicChallenge: Chokepoints and difficult crossings dominate expansion.
themes.twist: A small number of crossings can control large portions of the map.

themes.name: Skyreach Highlands
themes.visualIdentity: Rolling highlands, dramatic ridges, and elevated plateaus.
themes.strategicChallenge: Movement between elevations is slower or more costly.
themes.twist: High ground provides useful strategic advantages.

themes.name: Shattered Peaks
themes.visualIdentity: Jagged mountain landscape divided into isolated valleys.
themes.twist: Conquering a mountain pass can suddenly connect several regions.

themes.name: The Craterlands
themes.visualIdentity: Enormous impact crater with a fertile interior and harsh outer rim.
themes.strategicChallenge: Valuable central territory is surrounded by difficult approaches.
themes.twist: The world naturally creates a fight-toward-the-middle structure.

themes.name: The Great Delta
themes.visualIdentity: Rivers branching into many channels, fertile islands, and river cities.
themes.twist: River corridors provide unusually efficient movement and trade.

themes.name: The Lake Kingdoms
themes.visualIdentity: Enormous inland lake surrounded by developed shores and islands.
themes.twist: Central lake territories become valuable connectors.

themes.name: The Coral Coast
themes.visualIdentity: Colorful coastal world with shallow seas, beaches, and little islands.
themes.twist: Expansion naturally follows the shoreline.

themes.name: Thousand Isles
themes.visualIdentity: Extreme archipelago, much more fragmented than the first archipelago world.
themes.twist: Tiny islands become stepping stones for expansion.

themes.name: The River Kingdom
themes.visualIdentity: One enormous river winding through the entire world.
themes.strategicChallenge: The river divides the map into distinct strategic zones.
themes.twist: Bridges and crossings become exceptionally important.

themes.name: Island of Embers
themes.visualIdentity: Volcanic island chain, black rock, ash, and glowing volcanic areas.
themes.twist: Dangerous areas can contain exceptionally valuable resources.

themes.name: The Firebelt
themes.visualIdentity: Broad volcanic region with several active volcanic zones.
themes.strategicChallenge: Territory near volcanic areas is risky to develop.
themes.twist: Risky land is also unusually resource-rich.

themes.name: Obsidian Frontier
themes.visualIdentity: Dark volcanic landscape with obsidian formations and dramatic cliffs.
themes.twist: Rare resources encourage expansion into otherwise undesirable regions.

themes.name: The Mushroom Vale
themes.visualIdentity: Oversized mushrooms, glowing forests, and colorful valleys.
themes.strategicChallenge: Resource locations are scattered unusually far apart.
themes.twist: Seemingly useless regions can turn out to be excellent development areas.

themes.name: The Overgrown Empire
themes.visualIdentity: Abandoned settlements being reclaimed by vegetation.
themes.strategicChallenge: Valuable old infrastructure is scattered throughout the wilderness.
themes.twist: Exploration and development of old ruins are unusually important.

themes.name: The Land of Giants
themes.visualIdentity: Enormous environmental features such as giant trees, huge rocks, rivers, and sprawling valleys.
themes.twist: A territory can look small on the strategic map while representing a very large local area.

themes.name: The Golden Age
themes.visualIdentity: Already-developed farmland, prosperous cities, roads, and established settlements.
themes.twist: The player develops an already-civilized world rather than starting from wilderness.

themes.name: The Frontier
themes.visualIdentity: Developed heartland on one side and unexplored wilderness on the other.
themes.strategicChallenge: Expansion versus consolidating what you already own.
themes.twist: The map has a visible frontier that gradually moves outward.

themes.name: The Trade Roads
themes.visualIdentity: Crossroads, villages, merchant towns, and long roads connecting regions.
themes.strategicChallenge: Strategically useful land is concentrated around transportation corridors.
themes.twist: Controlling connections matters almost as much as controlling territory.

themes.name: The Broken Kingdom
themes.visualIdentity: Ruins of a former civilization scattered across a fragmented landscape.
themes.twist: Rebuilding old infrastructure is more attractive than developing completely new territory.

themes.name: The Richlands
themes.visualIdentity: Extraordinarily fertile, resource-rich world.
themes.strategicChallenge: Rapid AI expansion because everybody wants the same abundance.
themes.twist: This is intentionally an aggressive-expansion economy rather than a scarcity world.

themes.name: The Empty Expanse
themes.visualIdentity: Enormous open plains with very little natural obstruction.
themes.strategicChallenge: Few places to hide behind geography; borders are broad and exposed.
themes.twist: Expansion can happen in many directions simultaneously.

themes.name: The Golden Plains
themes.visualIdentity: Endless golden grass, wheat fields, and rolling hills.
themes.strategicChallenge: Very open geography with few natural defensive barriers.
themes.twist: Expansion is easy, but defending a huge frontier is difficult.

themes.name: The Green Steppe
themes.visualIdentity: Broad green plains dotted with small lakes and settlements.
themes.twist: Mobile expansion and rapid territorial changes.

themes.name: The Painted Prairie
themes.visualIdentity: Wildflowers, prairie grass, distant mesas, and colorful skies.
themes.twist: Development is spread broadly rather than concentrated.

themes.name: The Great Savannah
themes.visualIdentity: Tall grasses, scattered trees, and rocky outcrops.
themes.twist: Seasonal abundance and scarcity.

themes.name: The Windlands
themes.visualIdentity: Huge windswept plains with dramatic grass movement and exposed hills.
themes.twist: Periodic high-wind events temporarily change which areas are practical.

themes.name: The Rolling Kingdom
themes.visualIdentity: Gently rolling countryside with villages, farms, and hedgerows.
themes.twist: Unusually balanced map that rewards long-term development.

themes.name: Redstone Badlands
themes.visualIdentity: Red cliffs, mesas, dry valleys, and winding ravines.
themes.twist: Apparently small regions can control large portions of the map.

themes.name: The Salt Flats
themes.visualIdentity: White salt plains, shallow pools, and distant mountains.
themes.twist: Enormous open strategic visibility.

themes.name: Dustbowl Country
themes.visualIdentity: Dry farmland, dust storms, and abandoned homesteads.
themes.twist: Weather can temporarily turn productive land into problematic land.

themes.name: Sunken Valley
themes.visualIdentity: A huge depression surrounded by elevated terrain.
themes.strategicChallenge: Valuable central territory is surrounded by difficult approaches.
themes.twist: Control of the rim and control of the interior are very different strategic goals.

themes.name: The Dry Riverlands
themes.visualIdentity: Enormous dry riverbeds winding through an arid world.
themes.strategicChallenge: Settlements naturally cluster around old watercourses.
themes.twist: Rare water sources become strategic anchors.

themes.name: Emerald Jungle
themes.visualIdentity: Dense tropical vegetation, waterfalls, and giant trees.
themes.strategicChallenge: Dense terrain restricts expansion and visibility.
themes.twist: Cleared land becomes unusually valuable.

themes.name: The Monsoon Realm
themes.visualIdentity: Tropical forests, rice-like agriculture, and huge rivers.
themes.twist: Flood seasons temporarily alter routes and agricultural productivity.

themes.name: Orchid Isles
themes.visualIdentity: Lush islands covered in unusual flowers and vegetation.
themes.twist: Some tiny islands contain disproportionately valuable resources.

themes.name: The Green Labyrinth
themes.visualIdentity: Dense vegetation broken by narrow corridors and clearings.
themes.twist: Discovering the best routes becomes strategically important.

themes.name: The Jungle Coast
themes.visualIdentity: Tropical jungle meeting long beaches and coastal rivers.
themes.strategicChallenge: Resources and settlements are split between interior and coast.
themes.twist: Two very different expansion directions compete for attention.

themes.name: The Black Marsh
themes.visualIdentity: Dark wetlands, twisted trees, pools, and fog.
themes.strategicChallenge: Large portions of the map are difficult to traverse.
themes.twist: Safe dry ground becomes extremely valuable.

themes.name: Mistfen
themes.visualIdentity: Pale mist, marsh grasses, boardwalks, and isolated settlements.
themes.twist: Some information about neighboring territory is temporarily obscured.

themes.name: Reed Kingdom
themes.visualIdentity: Enormous reed beds, shallow water, and floating settlements.
themes.twist: Waterways become the primary infrastructure.

themes.name: The Flooded Forest
themes.visualIdentity: Half-submerged forests, islands of dry land, and rivers everywhere.
themes.twist: The map gradually changes which routes are convenient.

themes.name: Frostpine Valley
themes.visualIdentity: Snowy pine forests, frozen lakes, and mountain villages.
themes.twist: Sheltered valleys are disproportionately valuable.

themes.name: The Glacier Frontier
themes.visualIdentity: Glaciers, rocky valleys, and frozen rivers.
themes.twist: Habitable territory is concentrated into narrow corridors.

themes.name: Autumn Highlands
themes.visualIdentity: Mountains covered in brilliant autumn forests.
themes.twist: The world visually changes as time progresses.

themes.name: The White Basin
themes.visualIdentity: Broad snowy basin surrounded by mountains.
themes.strategicChallenge: One large enclosed area with limited entrances.
themes.twist: Whoever controls the passes controls access to the interior.

themes.name: The Northern Lakes
themes.visualIdentity: Countless icy lakes separated by forest and rocky hills.
themes.strategicChallenge: Fragmented geography without becoming a full archipelago.
themes.twist: Lake corridors create unusual travel networks.

themes.name: The Sapphire Coast
themes.visualIdentity: Cliffs, beaches, coastal forests, and bright blue water.
themes.twist: Valuable coastal territory attracts intense competition.

themes.name: The Storm Coast
themes.visualIdentity: Dramatic cliffs, rough seas, lighthouses, and stormy weather.
themes.twist: Protected harbors become exceptionally valuable.

themes.name: The Sunset Coast
themes.visualIdentity: Warm coastal plains, vineyards or farms, fishing villages, and cliffs.
themes.twist: Prosperity attracts rapid AI expansion.

themes.name: The Broken Coast
themes.visualIdentity: Deeply indented coastline with countless bays and peninsulas.
themes.twist: Narrow land bridges and coastal chokepoints.

themes.name: The Grand River
themes.visualIdentity: One enormous river winding through the whole world.
themes.twist: Bridges become strategic infrastructure.

themes.name: Seven Lakes
themes.visualIdentity: Seven enormous interconnected lakes.
themes.twist: Each lake basin has its own strategic character.

themes.name: The Waterways
themes.visualIdentity: Canals, rivers, ponds, and developed river settlements.
themes.twist: Infrastructure connecting waterways becomes strategically important.

themes.name: The Lake of Crowns
themes.visualIdentity: A huge central lake surrounded by prosperous settlements.
themes.strategicChallenge: The best land is concentrated around the water.
themes.twist: The central lake organizes the whole map.

themes.name: The Fallen Empire
themes.visualIdentity: Broken roads, ruined cities, old walls, and abandoned settlements.
themes.twist: Old infrastructure can be reclaimed instead of built from scratch.

themes.name: The Ancient Roads
themes.visualIdentity: An old civilization's enormous road network still crisscrossing the map.
themes.twist: Controlling major junctions provides strategic advantages.

themes.name: The Lost Kingdom
themes.visualIdentity: Scattered ruins hidden among forests, hills, and fields.
themes.twist: Exploration and redevelopment become unusually important.

themes.name: The Reclaimed Land
themes.visualIdentity: Abandoned settlements gradually being overtaken by nature.
themes.strategicChallenge: Developed territory starts in poor condition.
themes.twist: Rebuilding old places can be more valuable than establishing new ones.

themes.name: The Orchard Kingdom
themes.visualIdentity: Massive orchards, agricultural towns, mills, and countryside.
themes.twist: Food abundance becomes an economic strength.

themes.name: The Merchant Coast
themes.visualIdentity: Bustling ports, roads, markets, and coastal settlements.
themes.strategicChallenge: Economically valuable territory becomes highly contested.
themes.twist: Trade routes influence where empires expand.

themes.name: Blossom Kingdom
themes.visualIdentity: Flowering trees, bright green fields, streams, and blooming valleys.
themes.strategicChallenge: Rapid natural growth continually changes the appearance of undeveloped areas.
themes.twist: Fertile regions become especially desirable.

themes.name: The Vernal Vale
themes.visualIdentity: Spring rain, wildflowers, misty hills, and fresh forests.
themes.twist: Waterways and farmland gradually become more important.

themes.name: Cherry Blossom Highlands
themes.visualIdentity: Pink flowering forests and dramatic green mountain valleys.
themes.strategicChallenge: Difficult terrain divides otherwise fertile land.
themes.twist: Beautiful but strategically awkward mountain corridors.

themes.name: The Awakening
themes.visualIdentity: A dormant world bursting back into life.
themes.strategicChallenge: Different areas become productive at different times.
themes.twist: The world gradually becomes greener and more developed-looking.

themes.name: Rainy Springlands
themes.visualIdentity: Lush countryside, puddles, streams, rain, and fresh vegetation.
themes.twist: Agriculture is exceptionally valuable.

themes.name: Endless Summer
themes.visualIdentity: Sunny countryside, beaches, bright forests, and long days.
themes.twist: Almost everyone wants the same fertile territory.

themes.name: Sunflower Fields
themes.visualIdentity: Gigantic sunflower fields, farms, windmills, and rolling countryside.
themes.strategicChallenge: Agricultural land is concentrated into a few major regions.
themes.twist: Controlling those regions dramatically improves the economy.

themes.name: The Summer Coast
themes.visualIdentity: Bright beaches, cliffs, palms, fishing towns, and blue water.
themes.twist: Coastal settlements are unusually valuable.

themes.name: Midsummer Realm
themes.visualIdentity: Perpetual golden-hour lighting, warm forests, and enormous fields.
themes.twist: Expansion is easy, but defending a huge frontier is difficult.

themes.name: Crimson Autumn
themes.visualIdentity: Red, orange, and gold forests everywhere.
themes.twist: Food-rich regions become strategic targets.

themes.name: Harvest Kingdom
themes.visualIdentity: Enormous pumpkin patches, barns, orchards, wheat fields, and villages.
themes.strategicChallenge: Players compete for the most productive agricultural regions.
themes.twist: Exceptionally strong food economy.

themes.name: The Foggy Fall
themes.visualIdentity: Autumn forests, misty hills, fallen leaves, and quiet villages.
themes.strategicChallenge: Visibility is reduced in some regions.
themes.twist: Exploration becomes more important.

themes.name: Maple Highlands
themes.visualIdentity: Mountains covered in brilliant red and orange maple forests.
themes.twist: Valleys contain unusually valuable settlements.

themes.name: Haunted Harvest
themes.visualIdentity: Autumn countryside, pumpkins, crooked trees, moonlight, and old farms.
themes.twist: Spooky abandoned locations can become valuable once reclaimed.

themes.name: Witchwood
themes.visualIdentity: Twisted forests, glowing mushrooms, strange clearings, and tiny cottages.
themes.twist: Hidden shortcuts connect otherwise distant areas.

themes.name: Moonlit Marsh
themes.visualIdentity: Foggy wetlands beneath a giant moon.
themes.strategicChallenge: Movement through the marsh is difficult.
themes.twist: Dry islands act as valuable strategic anchors.

themes.name: The Midnight Kingdom
themes.visualIdentity: Perpetual nighttime, lantern-lit cities, dark forests, and starry skies.
themes.strategicChallenge: Visibility is limited outside developed territory.
themes.twist: Cities become islands of security.

themes.name: Crimson Moon
themes.visualIdentity: A strange red moon hanging over an autumn landscape.
themes.strategicChallenge: Temporary world events become more frequent.
themes.twist: The map visually changes during special events.

themes.name: Frosted Kingdom
themes.visualIdentity: Snowy villages, frozen rivers, decorated towns, and pine forests.
themes.twist: Settlements near sheltered valleys are especially valuable.

themes.name: The Great Snowfall
themes.visualIdentity: A world buried under enormous amounts of snow.
themes.twist: Previously insignificant corridors become important when others are blocked.

themes.name: Christmas Village
themes.visualIdentity: Cozy winter villages, lights, snow-covered pine trees, and decorated buildings.
themes.twist: Settlements are densely concentrated.

themes.name: Candy Cane Mountains
themes.visualIdentity: Whimsical snowy mountains with bright red-and-white visual motifs.
themes.twist: Narrow passes dominate the map.

themes.name: The Long Night
themes.visualIdentity: Winter twilight, auroras, snow, and frozen lakes.
themes.twist: The player develops around a few safe, prosperous regions.

themes.name: Snowglobe Kingdom
themes.visualIdentity: Tiny-looking cozy villages inside enormous snowy landscapes.
themes.twist: Dense settlements surrounded by huge wilderness.

themes.name: Monsoon Kingdom
themes.visualIdentity: Tropical forests, heavy rain, and swelling rivers.
themes.twist: Waterways become the dominant transportation network.

themes.name: Stormlands
themes.visualIdentity: Dark clouds, dramatic skies, plains, and cliffs.
themes.twist: Sheltered regions become strategic safe havens.

themes.name: Thunder Valley
themes.visualIdentity: Huge mountains and valleys frequently lit by lightning.
themes.twist: The safest routes wind through narrow valleys.

themes.name: The Four Winds
themes.visualIdentity: A world divided into visibly different wind and weather zones.
themes.twist: The player adapts expansion direction to changing conditions.

themes.name: Eclipse Realm
themes.visualIdentity: A world permanently caught beneath a giant eclipse.
themes.twist: Sections of the map have dramatically different lighting.

themes.name: Starlight Kingdom
themes.visualIdentity: Dark blue landscape under an enormous star-filled sky.
themes.strategicChallenge: Distant settlements are difficult to support.
themes.twist: Isolated developed regions become valuable strongholds.

themes.name: Aurora Lands
themes.visualIdentity: Northern lights, snowy hills, lakes, and forests.
themes.twist: Visual landmarks make certain regions exceptionally recognizable.

themes.name: The Twin Moons
themes.visualIdentity: Every night has two enormous moons.
themes.twist: A distinct visual cycle separates this world from earlier maps.

themes.name: Giant Mushroom Forest
themes.visualIdentity: Enormous mushrooms replacing ordinary trees.
themes.twist: Mushrooms create natural corridors and barriers.

themes.name: Mirrorlands
themes.visualIdentity: Strangely symmetrical geography, reflective lakes, and mirrored valleys.
themes.strategicChallenge: Opposing sides of the map tend to have similar resources.
themes.twist: Expansion decisions become surprisingly symmetrical.

themes.name: The Giant's Garden
themes.visualIdentity: Ordinary-looking flowers, rocks, and plants rendered at enormous scale.
themes.twist: Familiar props feel like massive terrain features.

themes.name: The Tiny Kingdom
themes.visualIdentity: Densely packed miniature-looking settlements and tiny islands.
themes.twist: Territorial competition becomes extremely concentrated.

themes.name: Upside-Down Valley
themes.visualIdentity: Visually surreal cliffs and hanging-looking formations while remaining a 2D playable world.
themes.twist: Orientation and landmarks feel completely different from previous worlds.

themes.name: The Floating Isles
themes.visualIdentity: Isolated floating-looking landmasses surrounded by clouds and sky effects.
themes.twist: Territory connections are sparse and strategically important.

themes.name: The Living Forest
themes.visualIdentity: Enormous trees, shifting clearings, and vegetation-covered settlements.
themes.strategicChallenge: Some routes become less convenient as nature spreads.
themes.twist: Undeveloped territory visually takes over the map.

themes.name: The Impossible Coast
themes.visualIdentity: Bizarre coastline with enormous natural arches, circular bays, narrow peninsulas, and strange islands.
themes.twist: The map itself creates unexpected strategic pathways.
